proof_body:
by
  intro R M _ _ _ _ _ _
  obtain ⟨n, ι, _, p, hp, e, ⟨f⟩⟩ := Module.equiv_free_prod_directSum R M
  classical
  let k := Fintype.equivFin ι
  refine ⟨n, Fintype.card ι, fun j => p (k.symm j), fun j => e (k.symm j), fun j => hp _, ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact f.trans ((Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite R R (Fin n)).prodCongr ((DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype R ι _).trans (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' R (fun i => R ⧸ Submodule.span R {p i ^ e i}) k)))
target_source: ∀ (R M : Type*) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M], ∃ (n m : ℕ) (p : Fin m → R) (e : Fin m → ℕ), (∀ i, Irreducible (p i)) ∧ Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] ((Fin n → R) × (∀ j : Fin m, R ⧸ Submodule.span R {p j ^ e j})))
